title: cycle run record
description: One cycle's structured result — the dataset the loop emits. Defined in Phase 0 and never broken: triage priors, cost prediction, agent comparison, and dashboards are all consumers of this one table. Each (tree snapshot, RED probe) pair is a self-grading task; the gate is the oracle reward.

run_id.description: Orchestrator run this cycle belonged to (empty for a lone agent).

gap.description: Primary gap id worked (empty for no-work-left).

status.description: The cycle's outcome — never free text the orchestrator must interpret. 'decomposed' (additive, docs/plans/autonomous_solver.md): the gap was too big to close honestly this cycle, so it was RED-first split into sub-claims plus a sufficiency-checked assembly (covers_claim links each child back to this gap) instead of being force-closed or parked as stuck.

attempts.description: Honest attempts made on the gap this cycle.

tokens.description: Agent token spend, when the orchestrator knows it.

net_new_gaps.description: Gaps filed minus gaps closed beyond the primary (runaway-scope watchdog input).

regressions_caught.description: Closed-gap probes the gate caught going RED during this cycle (and that the cycle then repaired before promoting).

parked_reason.description: Required when status=parked: what was tried, why it failed — observations, never conclusions.

receipts.description: self_sha256 of each evidence receipt emitted at this cycle's gate run.

branches.description: The road not taken: decompositions considered and rejected, attempts abandoned. Additive — records without it remain valid.
